properties.title: Bytecode Required for Jump Analysis
properties.natural_language: Valid jump destination analysis REQUIRES contract bytecode to be loaded into EVM memory before get_valid_jump_destinations() is called
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call get_valid_jump_destinations(code): PRE(code != null AND length(code) >= 0)
properties.rationale: Jump analysis cannot proceed without bytecode; attempting analysis on null or invalid bytecode would cause undefined behavior

properties.title: JUMPDEST Positions Exclude PUSH Data
properties.natural_language: A position is NEVER a valid jump destination if it lies within a PUSH instruction's data segment, even if the byte value at that position equals 0x5B (JUMPDEST opcode)
properties.formal_spec: FORALL pos in valid_jump_destinations: NOT(EXISTS push_instr: pos > push_instr.start AND pos <= push_instr.start + push_instr.data_size)
properties.rationale: Critical security invariant - PUSH data can contain 0x5B bytes that must not be treated as valid jump targets to prevent arbitrary code execution attacks

properties.title: Valid Jump Destination Requires JUMPDEST Opcode
properties.natural_language: EVERY valid jump destination MUST contain the JUMPDEST opcode (0x5B) at that position AND be within bytecode bounds
properties.formal_spec: FORALL pos in valid_jump_destinations: bytecode[pos] == 0x5B AND pos < length(bytecode)
properties.rationale: EVM specification requires explicit JUMPDEST markers for control flow integrity

properties.title: Invalid Jump Halts Execution
properties.natural_language: WHEN a JUMP/JUMPI instruction targets a position NOT in the valid jump set, THEN execution MUST halt with an InvalidJumpDestination exception
properties.formal_spec: POST(JUMP(dest)): dest NOT IN valid_jump_set => state == STATE-EXECUTION-HALTED-INVALID-JUMP
properties.rationale: Security boundary enforcement - prevents arbitrary code execution by blocking jumps to unauthorized positions

properties.title: Valid Jump Updates Program Counter
properties.natural_language: WHEN a JUMP/JUMPI instruction targets a valid jump destination, THEN the program counter MUST be updated to that destination and execution continues
properties.formal_spec: POST(JUMP(dest)): dest IN valid_jump_set => PC == dest AND state == STATE-EXECUTION-CONTINUES
properties.rationale: Ensures correct control flow for valid jumps

properties.title: PUSH Data Size Correctly Calculated
properties.natural_language: FOR every PUSH-N instruction (0x60-0x7F), the data segment size MUST equal (opcode - 0x5F) bytes
properties.formal_spec: FORALL push_opcode in [0x60..0x7F]: data_size(push_opcode) == push_opcode - 0x5F
properties.rationale: Correct data size calculation is essential for properly excluding PUSH data from valid jump destinations

properties.title: Complete Bytecode Iteration
properties.natural_language: AFTER bytecode iteration completes, ALL positions within PUSH data segments MUST be marked as invalid jump destinations
properties.formal_spec: POST(iterate_bytecode): FORALL push in bytecode: FORALL i in [1..push.data_size]: (push.position + i) NOT IN valid_destinations
properties.rationale: Incomplete iteration would leave some PUSH data positions potentially exploitable

properties.title: Fork Configuration Required
properties.natural_language: Istanbul fork activation REQUIRES the fork block number to be configured in the chain configuration before block processing begins
properties.formal_spec: PRE(process_block): fork_config.istanbul_block != null
properties.rationale: Unconfigured fork would prevent proper fork transition and could cause consensus failures

properties.title: Fork Activation Irreversible
properties.natural_language: ONCE Istanbul fork is activated at block N, ALL subsequent blocks (N+1, N+2, ...) MUST apply Istanbul rules - fork cannot be deactivated
properties.formal_spec: FORALL block_num >= istanbul_activation_block: state(block_num) == STATE-ISTANBUL-ACTIVATED
properties.rationale: Fork irreversibility ensures consistent chain state and prevents reorg attacks that could bypass new rules

properties.title: All Bundled EIPs Activated Atomically
properties.natural_language: WHEN Istanbul fork activates, ALL bundled EIPs (152, 1108, 1344, 1884, 2028, 2200) MUST be activated simultaneously in the same block
properties.formal_spec: POST(activate_istanbul): FORALL eip IN [152, 1108, 1344, 1884, 2028, 2200]: is_active(eip) == true
properties.rationale: Partial activation would create inconsistent state and potential security vulnerabilities

properties.title: Fork State Required for Gas Calculation
properties.natural_language: Gas cost calculation REQUIRES knowledge of current fork state (pre/post Istanbul) to apply correct gas pricing
properties.formal_spec: PRE(calculate_gas): fork_state IN {PRE_ISTANBUL, POST_ISTANBUL}
properties.rationale: Ambiguous fork state would result in incorrect gas calculations and potential execution failures

properties.title: Consistent Gas Pricing Within Block
properties.natural_language: ALL opcode executions within the same block MUST use the same gas pricing model (pre-Istanbul or post-Istanbul), never mixed
properties.formal_spec: FORALL tx1, tx2 in same_block: gas_model(tx1) == gas_model(tx2)
properties.rationale: Mixed gas pricing within a block would create inconsistent execution costs and potential consensus failures

properties.title: Out of Gas Halts Execution
properties.natural_language: WHEN calculated gas cost exceeds remaining gas limit, THEN execution MUST halt with out-of-gas error regardless of fork state
properties.formal_spec: POST(calculate_gas): gas_cost > remaining_gas => state == STATE-OUT-OF-GAS
properties.rationale: Consistent gas limit enforcement prevents unbounded computation

properties.title: Valid Precompile Address Required
properties.natural_language: Precompile execution REQUIRES target address to be a recognized precompile address (0x01-0x09 post-Istanbul)
properties.formal_spec: PRE(execute_precompile): address IN precompile_addresses(fork_state)
properties.rationale: Calls to non-precompile addresses must follow standard contract call logic

properties.title: Blake2b Only Available Post-Istanbul
properties.natural_language: The Blake2b precompile at address 0x09 is ONLY available after Istanbul activation - calls before fork MUST fail
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call to 0x09: is_active(call.block) >= istanbul_block OR result == FAILURE
properties.rationale: Precompile availability must match fork activation to maintain consensus

properties.title: Precompile Returns Output on Success
properties.natural_language: WHEN precompile execution succeeds, THEN output data MUST be available and gas MUST be deducted according to Istanbul pricing
properties.formal_spec: POST(execute_precompile): success == true => output != null AND gas_used == istanbul_gas_cost(precompile)
properties.rationale: Successful precompile execution must produce valid output for calling contract

properties.title: Fork Block Reached for State Change
properties.natural_language: The DAO irregular state change REQUIRES the blockchain to reach exactly block 1,920,000 before apply_dao() is executed
properties.formal_spec: PRE(apply_dao): block_number == 1920000
properties.rationale: Premature or delayed execution would corrupt state or miss affected accounts

properties.title: All 117 Accounts Processed
properties.natural_language: The apply_dao() function MUST process ALL 117 addresses in DAO_ACCOUNTS list - no account may be skipped or processed twice
properties.formal_spec: FORALL addr in DAO_ACCOUNTS: count(processed, addr) == 1 AND total(processed) == 117
properties.rationale: Incomplete processing would leave attacker funds or fail to recover legitimate user funds

properties.title: Funds Conserved During Transfer
properties.natural_language: The sum of all balances moved to recovery contract MUST equal the sum of all balances debited from DAO accounts - no funds created or destroyed
properties.formal_spec: SUM(recovery_credit) == SUM(dao_account_debit) AND recovery_credit >= 0 AND dao_account_debit >= 0
properties.rationale: Balance conservation prevents inflation/deflation bugs during irregular state change

properties.title: DAO Accounts Zeroed After Fork
properties.natural_language: AFTER apply_dao() completes, ALL 117 DAO account balances MUST be zero
properties.formal_spec: POST(apply_dao): FORALL addr in DAO_ACCOUNTS: balance(addr) == 0
properties.rationale: Non-zero balances would indicate incomplete recovery or accounting errors

properties.title: Block Header Required for Validation
properties.natural_language: DAO fork header validation REQUIRES a complete block header with extra_data field present
properties.formal_spec: PRE(validate_header): header != null AND header.extra_data != null
properties.rationale: Incomplete headers cannot be validated for fork compliance

properties.title: Fork Window Exactly 10 Blocks
properties.natural_language: The DAO fork enforcement window is EXACTLY 10 blocks starting from the fork block - blocks 1,920,000 through 1,920,009 require the marker
properties.formal_spec: in_fork_window(block_num) IFF (block_num >= 1920000 AND block_num < 1920010)
properties.rationale: Incorrect window boundaries could accept invalid blocks or reject valid ones

properties.title: Fork Marker Required in Window
properties.natural_language: ALL blocks within the 10-block fork window MUST contain 'dao-hard-fork' in extra_data to be valid
properties.formal_spec: FORALL block in fork_window: block.extra_data.contains('dao-hard-fork') OR block.rejected
properties.rationale: Marker enforcement prevents non-fork-supporting miners from producing valid blocks during transition

properties.title: Invalid Marker Rejects Block
properties.natural_language: WHEN a block in the fork window lacks the 'dao-hard-fork' marker, THEN the block MUST be rejected and not added to the chain
properties.formal_spec: POST(validate_header): in_fork_window AND NOT has_marker => state == STATE-EXTRA-DATA-INVALID
properties.rationale: Accepting blocks without marker would allow non-forked chain to continue

properties.title: Recovery Contract Must Exist
properties.natural_language: WithdrawDAO withdrawal REQUIRES the recovery contract to exist at address 0xbf4ed7b27f1d666546e30d74d50d173d20bca754 with sufficient funds
properties.formal_spec: PRE(withdraw): contract_exists(0xbf4ed7...754) AND balance(0xbf4ed7...754) > 0
properties.rationale: Withdrawal attempts from non-existent or empty contract would fail

properties.title: Proportional Share Calculation
properties.natural_language: Each user's withdrawal amount MUST be proportional to their DAO token holdings relative to total supply
properties.formal_spec: withdrawal_amount(user) == (user_tokens / total_tokens) * total_recovery_funds
properties.rationale: Fair distribution requires accurate proportional calculation

properties.title: No Double Withdrawal
properties.natural_language: Each DAO token holder can withdraw ONLY ONCE - subsequent withdrawal attempts MUST fail
properties.formal_spec: FORALL user: count(successful_withdrawals, user) <= 1
properties.rationale: Double withdrawal would drain funds meant for other token holders

properties.title: Successful Withdrawal Transfers Funds
properties.natural_language: WHEN withdraw() succeeds, THEN the calculated ETH amount MUST be transferred to the user's address
properties.formal_spec: POST(withdraw): success => user_balance_after == user_balance_before + calculated_share
properties.rationale: Failed transfers after successful calculation would leave user without funds
